about.title: About Me
about.content1: Hello! My name is Ying Luo. I hold a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Ochanomizu University and currently work there as a postdoctoral researcher. My research focuses on the intersection of neuroscience and machine learning, particularly analyzing brain activity in response to various stimuli. In the future, I aim to focus more on research related to brain pathologies.
about.content2: In my free time, I enjoy traveling and experiencing different cultures. I am passionate about the potential of AI to advance human knowledge and improve daily life. Thank you for your interest in my field of study. Please feel free to browse through my publications, and don’t hesitate to reach out if you’d like to learn more about my research or explore potential postdoctoral or collaborative opportunities.
